meta.purpose: Convert item-level evidence into longitudinal student mastery without confusing isolated performance with stable ability.

recency.principle: recent independent evidence weighs more than old evidence

mastery_formula.description: weighted evidence score adjusted by confidence, recency and task diversity

status_rules.confirmed_weakness: 3+ clearly attributable errors across independent items/tasks
status_rules.persistent_weakness: confirmed weakness across at least two dates or sources
status_rules.improving: previous weakness with recent independent success trend
status_rules.mastered_monitoring: repeated recent success across independent tasks; continue spaced checks

trend_engine.window: last 5 usable evidence items per micro-skill

prerequisite_logic.rule: persistent higher-level weakness triggers prerequisite inspection
prerequisite_logic.repair_sequence: repair earliest demonstrated weak prerequisite, then retest upward

cross_domain_logic.example: repeated imbuhan error in grammar worksheet plus authentic essay raises confidence in same grammar node
cross_domain_logic.guardrail: single writing slip must not create grammar weakness
